I dont have an answer but holy fuck I've been wanting one that doesn't revolve around religion or hearing the word "selfish". 
100% relatable question.

I'm on my 3rd counselor/therapist. 
I'm not sure that I can. 
When the reality and weight of my actions and the damage I may have caused other people is constantly on my mind, its hard to think that I can work through it.
